title: V5: snapshot genesis_anchor — light checks, single sig, migrate
brief: Close trust-default hole: local snapshot can diverge from --genesis-file while genesis_accounts match. Implement ADR 0008: genesis_anchor in snapshot v3 wire (genesis_state_root, gencfg_digest, block1_hdr_hash, single Ed25519 fool-guard sig), light trust-load checks (no full replay), mandatory block@1 preflight when checkpoint>=1, migrate-on-load for legacy snapshots without anchor.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot v3 wire includes optional genesis_anchor (schema_v=1); save path always writes anchor when validator signing key available
Trust load: fail-closed if genesis_state_root or gencfg_digest != values from --genesis-file
Trust load: verify anchor signature when present; block@1 preflight (prev_gen, hdr_hash, PoA sig, replay txs→state_root) when checkpoint_height>=1
Migration: legacy snapshot without anchor — migrate-on-load with warn if preflight passes and node can sign; else explicit env/verify-chain path documented
Missing block@1 on disk with checkpoint>=1: fail with clear prune message
Unit tests in pwmd snapshot module; no default full replay requirement
code_touchpoints: crates/pwmd/src/snapshot/genesis.rs or new anchor.rs — gencfg_digest, anchor_preimage sign/verify
crates/pwmd/src/snapshot/incremental.rs — load block at height 1 for preflight
non_goals: k-of-n validator cosign on snapshot (→ RFC 0020 Bootstrap Snapshot)
pwm-cli migrate subcommand unless trivial; env + verify-chain fallback OK

bootstrap_compat.requirement: gencfg_digest and genesis_state_root algorithms must be stable and reusable; export from pwm-core or snapshot module for future bootstrap_preimage

delegations.prompt_summary: Implement ADR 0008 genesis_anchor light checks + migration per task brief
Review fail-closed semantics, migration safety, no bypass of block1 preflight on trust path
Anchor/preflight tests + snapshot suite regression; v3_replay_det_gate_ok
commands: cargo test -p pwmd --lib snapshot → 60 PASS, 2 ignored (pre-existing marks_quota)

notes: Conveyor closed: coding (bridge) + review PASS_WITH_NITS + testing PASS (local). Slice done. Follow-up out of scope: marks_quota on SnapshotStateV3 (testing-issues.md); review NIT cfg_dig /// comment.
